instruction: Add ground coffee to V60; make a well in the center with finger
Start timer; pour {water}g water (2x dose) in spiral from center outward
Swirl V60 in circular motion until slurry is even; no dry clumps
Let coffee bloom (CO₂ escaping); wait up to 45 seconds
Begin main pour: spiral pour aggressively to reach {water}g by 1:15 (60% of total)
Slow second pour: gently pour remaining water to reach {water_total}g by 1:45
Stir once clockwise, once counter-clockwise with spoon (knocks grounds off sides)
Allow V60 to drain slightly, then give a final gentle swirl
Wait for full drawdown; aim for flat coffee bed; total time ~3:30
Pour {water}g water slowly in concentric circle over 10 seconds (1st pour = 40% part 1)
Wait for water to drain completely before next pour
Pour {water}g water (2nd pour = 40% part 2); wait for full drain
Pour {water}g water (3rd pour = 60% part 1); wait for full drain
Pour {water}g water (4th pour = 60% part 2); wait for full drain
Pour {water}g water (5th pour = 60% part 3); wait for full drain
Extraction complete; remove V60 and serve
Add {coffee}g medium-ground coffee to French press (do NOT use coarse)
Start timer; pour all {water_total}g water in one go; saturate all grounds evenly
Wait 4 minutes with NO lid on; do not touch. A crust will form on top
Break the crust by stirring gently (clockwise + counter-clockwise)
Use two spoons to scoop off foam and floating particles from surface
Place lid on (plunger NOT pressed down); wait 5-8 more minutes
Gently push plunger down ONLY to just below the surface (not to bottom)
Pour gently into cup; leave last ~20ml to avoid disturbing settled grounds

title: Prep
instruction: Pour {water}g of 50°C bypass water into carafe first

title: Prep
instruction: Grind coffee (slow RPM); blow off chaff and sift out fines at 200μm
Place AeroPress upright on carafe; add sifted ground coffee to chamber
Pour {water}g of 84°C water into AeroPress; wet all coffee grounds
Stir in North-South-North-South then West-East-West-East pattern
Begin pressing gently for about 20 seconds
Press complete; coffee mixes with bypass water in carafe. Serve.

title: Prep
instruction: Set AeroPress inverted at the 4th mark; add {coffee}g coffee to chamber
1st Pour: Pour {water}g water using a Melodrip (takes 5-6 seconds)
Wait; let coffee bloom
2nd Pour: Pour {water}g more water (total {water_total}g) using Melodrip (takes ~10 sec)
Stir gently N-S-E-W pattern for 10 seconds
Rinse filter (1x Aesir); turn off kettle and remove lid
Cap the AeroPress; gently remove air (takes ~10 seconds)
Gently swirl AeroPress; place on server
Begin pressing gently; aim for 76-79g output in 30-40 seconds
Add warm water from kettle to ~130-135g total; add 20-30g room temp 0ppm water

title: Prep
instruction: Place Chemex filter (3 layers toward spout); rinse with hot water; discard
Add ground coffee; shake gently to level. Start timer.
Pour {water}g water to bloom; wet all grounds evenly in center spiral
Wait 30-45 seconds for bloom (coffee releases CO₂ and expands)
Begin main pour: slow spiral from center outward; avoid filter edges
Continue pouring steadily to reach {water_total}g total; pause if near rim
Allow full drawdown; aim for 3:30-4:30 total time
Remove filter and discard; serve immediately

title: Prep
instruction: Boil water in a kettle first (using pre-heated water reduces bitter extraction)

title: Step 1
instruction: Fill bottom chamber with {water_total}g hot water to just BELOW the safety valve

title: Step 2
instruction: Fill filter basket with fine-ground coffee; level off without tamping

title: Step 3
instruction: Assemble Moka pot; use a towel to hold hot bottom chamber

title: Step 4
instruction: Place on stove at LOW to MEDIUM heat; leave lid open to watch

title: Step 5
instruction: Coffee begins to flow into upper chamber; should be honey-colored stream

title: Step 6
instruction: When sputtering/gurgling starts, remove immediately from heat

title: Step 7
instruction: Cool bottom chamber under cold running water to stop extraction

title: Step 8
instruction: Serve immediately; can dilute or add steamed milk

title: Prep
instruction: Use light-medium roast specialty coffee; grind between Turkish and espresso

title: Step 1
instruction: Add {water_total}g of warm water (60-70°C) to copper cezve

title: Step 2
instruction: Add {coffee}g of finely ground coffee on top of the water

title: Step 3
instruction: Stir gently with wooden paddle until coffee is saturated and mixed

title: Step 4
instruction: Place on very low heat (gas flame, sand heater, or micro burner)

title: Step 5
instruction: Watch carefully; foam will begin to form and rise

title: Step 6
instruction: When foam reaches near the rim, remove from heat (SINGLE rise only)

title: Step 7
instruction: Pour slowly into demitasse cup to preserve foam layer on top

title: Step 8
instruction: Wait 1-2 minutes for grounds to settle; sip slowly

title: Step 1
instruction: Grind coffee very coarse (like raw sugar or coarse cornmeal)

title: Step 2
instruction: Add coffee to mason jar, French press, or cold brew pitcher

title: Step 3
instruction: Pour {water_total}g cold or room temperature filtered water over grounds

title: Step 4
instruction: Stir gently to ensure all grounds are saturated

title: Step 5
instruction: Cover container; place in refrigerator (or leave at room temp for faster extraction)

title: Step 6
instruction: Steep for 12-24 hours (fridge = 18-24h; room temp = 12-16h)

title: Step 7
instruction: Strain through fine mesh filter, then through cheesecloth or paper filter

title: Step 8
instruction: Concentrate can be diluted 1:1 with water or milk; serve over ice

title: Prep
instruction: Place Melitta #4 filter in Clever Dripper; rinse with hot water; drain off dripper stand
Add ground coffee; pour all {water_total}g water in one go (no bloom needed); start timer
Place lid on to retain heat
Stir gently to break any crust of floating grounds
Place Clever Dripper on carafe/mug to release the valve and begin drawdown
Drawdown takes 30-45 seconds through paper filter
Remove Clever Dripper; serve coffee

title: Prep
instruction: Attach cloth or paper filter to upper chamber; soak cloth if new

title: Step 1
instruction: Add {water_total}g water to lower globe; place on heat source (butane burner or halogen)

title: Step 2
instruction: As water heats, place upper chamber loosely on top (don't seal yet)

title: Step 3
instruction: When water begins boiling, press upper chamber to create seal

title: Step 4
instruction: Water rises to upper chamber via vacuum pressure

title: Step 5
instruction: Once most water is up top, add ground coffee; stir gently to submerge

title: Step 6
instruction: Let brew for 45-90 seconds in upper chamber

title: Step 7
instruction: Remove from heat; as lower globe cools, vacuum draws brewed coffee down through filter

title: Step 8
instruction: Remove upper chamber; serve from lower globe

title: Prep
instruction: Fold V60 paper filter seam; place in dripper on server. Rinse with hot water; discard.
Add ground coffee; shake to level. Start timer.
Bloom: pour {water}g water (2× coffee dose) in spiral from center out.
Wait 30 seconds for bloom; coffee releases CO₂ and expands.
Begin main pour: slow concentric circles from center outward; avoid filter edges.
Pour {water}g steadily; maintain water level about halfway up the slurry.
Complete final pour to reach {water_total}g total water weight.
Allow full drawdown. Aim for flat coffee bed.

title: Prep
instruction: Place Kalita Wave filter in dripper; rinse with hot water on server. Discard rinse water.
Add ground coffee; shake to level. Start timer.
Bloom: pour {water}g water to saturate all grounds; gentle swirl.
Wait 30-45 seconds for bloom.
Pour in slow concentric circles to ~60% of {water_total}g total water weight.
Pause briefly; let water draw down to near slurry level.
Resume pouring to reach {water_total}g final water weight; keep gentle, centered pours.
Full drawdown complete. Flat bed = even extraction.

title: Prep
instruction: Place paper filter in cap; rinse. Attach cap to AeroPress chamber; place on mug.
Add ground coffee. Start timer. Pour all {water_total}g water in steadily.
Stir gently 3-5 times back and forth.
Let coffee steep (some will drip through—this is normal in upright method).
Insert plunger and press down slowly with steady pressure for 20-30 seconds.
Stop pressing when you hear a hiss (air pushing through).

title: Done
instruction: Remove AeroPress. Optionally dilute with hot water for an Americano-style cup.

title: Prep
instruction: Warm up machine for 15-30 min. Flush group head with water.

title: Step 1
instruction: Dose {coffee}g of freshly ground coffee into portafilter basket.

title: Step 2
instruction: Distribute grounds evenly (WDT tool or tap); tamp level with ~15kg pressure.

title: Step 3
instruction: Lock portafilter into group head. Place cup underneath.

title: Step 4
instruction: Start extraction; timer begins when pump activates.

title: Step 5
instruction: Watch flow: should start as slow drips, then thin steady stream ('mouse tail').

title: Step 6
instruction: Target {water_total}g output (for {coffee}g dose) in 25-35 seconds.

title: Step 7
instruction: Stop shot. Serve immediately.

title: Prep
instruction: Place Phin filter on glass/cup. Add 2-3 tbsp sweetened condensed milk to glass (for cà phê sữa đá).

title: Step 1
instruction: Add coffee grounds to Phin chamber; shake to level.

title: Step 2
instruction: Place gravity press/filter screen on top; press gently to compress slightly.

title: Step 3
instruction: Add a small splash of hot water ({water}g) to bloom the grounds for 20 seconds.

title: Step 4
instruction: Fill Phin with remaining {water}g hot water to the top.

title: Step 5
instruction: Place lid on Phin; wait as coffee slowly drips through (4-6 minutes total).

title: Step 6
instruction: When dripping stops, remove Phin. Stir condensed milk into coffee.

title: Step 7
instruction: For iced version: pour over a full glass of ice.

title: Prep
instruction: Place {water}g of ice cubes into server/carafe below the dripper.

title: Prep
instruction: Set up V60/Chemex with rinsed paper filter on top of ice-filled server.
Add ground coffee (grind slightly finer than normal hot pour over). Start timer.
Bloom with {water}g hot water; wait 30 seconds.
Pour remaining {water}g hot water in slow spirals (total hot water = ~60% of recipe).
Complete pour; allow full drawdown. Hot coffee drips directly onto ice.

title: Done
instruction: Swirl server to melt remaining ice and chill evenly. Pour into glass.

title: Prep
instruction: Ensure South Indian brass/steel coffee filter is clean and dry.

title: Step 1
instruction: Add coffee powder (often with 20-30% chicory) to top perforated chamber.

title: Step 2
instruction: Gently press down with the plunger disc to level (do NOT compress hard).

title: Step 3
instruction: Pour {water_total}g boiling water (96-100°C) over the grounds; fill top chamber.

title: Step 4
instruction: Close with lid; let decoction drip into bottom chamber (15-20 min quick; 3-4 hrs traditional).

title: Step 5
instruction: Meanwhile, boil full-fat milk in a saucepan.

title: Step 6
instruction: Add 2 tbsp strong decoction to tumbler; add boiled milk (ratio to taste, ~1:1 to 1:2).

title: Step 7
instruction: Add sugar to taste. Pour between tumbler and dabara from height to aerate and create froth.

title: Step 1
instruction: Place paper filter disc at bottom of middle coffee chamber.

title: Step 2
instruction: Add medium-coarse ground coffee; level the bed.

title: Step 3
instruction: Place a second wetted paper filter on top of the coffee grounds.

title: Step 4
instruction: Fill top water reservoir with ice and {water_total}g cold water.

title: Step 5
instruction: Adjust valve to achieve ~1 drip per second (this is critical).

title: Step 6
instruction: Let drip for 3-12 hours depending on tower model and desired strength.

title: Step 7
instruction: Collect concentrate in bottom carafe.

title: Step 8
instruction: Serve over ice; dilute if needed. Can be stored in fridge for 1-2 weeks.

title: Prep
instruction: Rinse V60 filter; preheat dripper and server. Add coffee; create flat bed.
Start timer. Pour {water}g water (3× dose) for bloom; aggressive pour to saturate.
Use spoon to stir/excavate grounds ensuring all are wet (the 'Rao Spin').
Wait for bloom. CO₂ escapes.
Begin main pour: continuous slow spiral from center out and back. Do NOT stop and start.
One single uninterrupted pour to {water_total}g total. Keep water level steady.
Perform gentle 'Rao Spin' – swirl dripper once to flatten bed and knock down high/dry grounds.
Allow full drawdown. Flat bed at end.

title: Prep
instruction: Place V60 tabbed paper filter in Switch; rinse with hot water. Close the valve (switch down).
Add ground coffee. Start timer. Pour all {water_total}g water in one go.
Stir gently 2-3 times to ensure all grounds are saturated.
Wait for full steep with valve closed (immersion phase).
Open the valve (switch up); coffee begins to drain through paper filter.
Drawdown takes ~45-60 seconds through V60 paper.
Remove dripper. Serve.
Rinse paper filter; add {coffee}g coffee to V60. Start timer.
Pour {water}g water (3.3× dose) for bloom; swirl to saturate all grounds.
Wait 45 seconds for bloom.
Pour #2: {water}g water in gentle concentric circles.
Pour #3: {water}g water.
Pour #4: {water}g water.
Pour #5: {water}g water (total now {water_total}g).
Give V60 a final gentle swirl to level the bed.
Wait for full drawdown. Aim for flat coffee bed at bottom.

title: Prep
instruction: Soak flannel filter in hot water. Wring out excess. Attach to nel drip stand/handle.

title: Prep
instruction: Pre-wet filter with hot water to remove residual flavor. Discard rinse water.
Add ground coffee to flannel filter. Create a small well in center.
Start timer. Pour {water}g water gently into center for bloom.
Wait 30 seconds. Coffee swells and releases CO₂.
Begin slow center pour: thin stream, center spiraling gently outward.
Continue in slow pulses to reach {water_total}g total. Keep water level low — do NOT flood the filter.
Allow remaining water to drip through fully.
Preheat French press with hot water; discard.
Add {coffee}g coarse-ground coffee to French press.
Start timer. Pour all {water_total}g water vigorously to saturate all grounds.
Stir once briefly with a spoon to break up any dry clumps.
Place lid on French press with plunger pulled up. Do not press yet.
Press plunger down slowly and evenly all the way to the bottom.
Pour immediately into cups to prevent over-extraction.

title: Prep
instruction: Insert plunger into chamber at the 4 mark. Flip upside down (plunger on bottom).

title: Prep
instruction: Place paper filter in cap; rinse with hot water. Set cap aside.
Add ground coffee to inverted chamber. Start timer.
Pour {water_total}g water to desired level. Leave space for cap.
Stir gently 3-5 times back and forth.
Attach rinsed filter cap. Screw on firmly.
Carefully and confidently flip AeroPress onto cup/server. Hold firmly!
Press plunger down slowly and steadily (~30 seconds). Stop at hiss.
Remove AeroPress. Dilute with hot water if desired.

title: Prep
instruction: Place paper filter in cap; rinse. Assemble AeroPress upright on cup.
Add {coffee}g coffee. Start timer. Pour all {water_total}g water in one go. Do NOT stir.
Wait 2 full minutes. Some coffee will drip through — that's OK.
Swirl the AeroPress gently 3 times (no spoon needed).
Press down slowly and gently for ~30 seconds.
Stop at hiss. Serve immediately.

title: Step 1
instruction: Add {water_total}g cold filtered water to cezve (ibrik).

title: Step 2
instruction: Add {coffee}g extra-fine coffee (like talcum powder). Add sugar now if desired.

title: Step 3
instruction: Stir gently to combine coffee, water, and sugar evenly.

title: Step 4
instruction: Place cezve on LOW heat. Do NOT rush — gentle heating is critical.

title: Step 5
instruction: Watch for foam to begin forming on the surface (~1:30-2:00).

title: Step 6
instruction: When foam rises near the rim, remove from heat. Let settle 20-30 seconds.

title: Step 7
instruction: Return to heat. Let foam rise a SECOND time. Remove from heat.

title: Step 8
instruction: Return to heat for a THIRD and final foam rise. Remove from heat.

title: Step 9
instruction: Optional: splash 1 tsp cold water to help grounds settle faster.

title: Step 10
instruction: Pour slowly into demitasse cup, preserving foam on top. Wait 1-2 min to sip.

title: Step 1
instruction: Fill water reservoir with {water_total}g fresh filtered water.

title: Step 2
instruction: Place paper or permanent filter in basket.

title: Step 3
instruction: Add {coffee}g medium-ground coffee to filter basket.

title: Step 4
instruction: Close basket. Press Start/Brew button.

title: Step 5
instruction: Machine heats water and drips through coffee bed automatically.

title: Step 6
instruction: Brewing completes in 5-8 minutes. Serve from carafe.

title: Step 7
instruction: Remove basket/filter to stop dripping onto hot plate.

title: Step 1
instruction: Add {water_total}g cold water to bottom chamber of percolator.

title: Step 2
instruction: Place filter basket on stem. Add {coffee}g coarse-ground coffee to basket.

title: Step 3
instruction: Assemble percolator. Place on heat (or plug in).

title: Step 4
instruction: Water heats, rises through tube, rains over coffee, drips back down and repeats.

title: Step 5
instruction: Watch through glass knob on lid: aim for medium-amber color.

title: Step 6
instruction: Allow to cycle for 7-10 minutes.

title: Step 7
instruction: Remove from heat IMMEDIATELY at desired strength. Over-perking = bitter.

title: Step 8
instruction: Let sit 1-2 minutes for grounds to settle, then serve.

title: Prep
instruction: Rinse paper filter in V60 or Cafec Flower Dripper. Place on server.
Add {coffee}g coffee (medium grind — coarser than standard V60). Level bed.
Start timer. Pour {water}g water for bloom; wait 45 seconds.
Begin ultra-slow center pour: pour ONLY in the very center in a thin stream.
Continue slow center pour ({water}g remaining). Water should barely rise above the coffee bed level.
When all {water_total}g has been poured, allow final drawdown.
Drawdown may take longer than standard V60 — that's expected.

title: Prep
instruction: Grind {coffee}g per bowl (slightly coarser than French press). Set out cupping bowls.

title: Prep
instruction: Prepare tasting spoons, rinse water, and spit cup.

title: Step 1
instruction: Evaluate DRY FRAGRANCE: lean in and smell the dry grounds in each bowl.
Start timer. Pour {water_total}g of 93°C water directly onto grounds in each bowl.
Wait exactly 4 minutes. A crust of grounds forms on the surface.
BREAK THE CRUST: lean in close, push grounds aside with spoon 3 times. Inhale aroma deeply.
Skim off foam and floating grounds with two spoons. Discard into waste bowl.
Let coffee cool 5-8 minutes. Grounds settle to bottom.
TASTE: slurp aggressively from spoon to spray coffee across entire palate. Evaluate flavor, acidity, body, balance, sweetness, aftertaste.

title: Step 1
instruction: Add {water_total}g water to a pot or saucepan.

title: Step 2
instruction: Bring to a full rolling boil over campfire or stove.

title: Step 3
instruction: Remove pot from heat. Wait 30 seconds for boiling to subside.

title: Step 4
instruction: Add {coffee}g coarse-ground coffee. Stir once gently.

title: Step 5
instruction: Cover pot. Let steep for 4-5 minutes off heat.

title: Step 6
instruction: Splash ~30ml cold water on top to help grounds settle.

title: Step 7
instruction: Wait 2-3 more minutes for grounds to sink.

title: Step 8
instruction: Pour carefully from the top into cups, leaving sediment behind in pot.

title: Step 1
instruction: Boil water in a kettle.

title: Step 2
instruction: Add {coffee}g very finely ground coffee into a cup or glass.

title: Step 3
instruction: Add sugar to taste (traditional: 1-2 teaspoons).

title: Step 4
instruction: Pour {water_total}g boiling water directly onto grounds.

title: Step 5
instruction: Stir briefly (3-4 times) to dissolve sugar and wet all grounds.

title: Step 6
instruction: Wait 3-5 minutes for grounds to settle to the bottom.

title: Step 7
instruction: Sip carefully from the top. Do NOT disturb settled grounds.

title: Step 8
instruction: Stop drinking when you reach the sludge layer — leave the last ~20ml.

title: Step 1
instruction: Fill bottom water chamber with {water_total}g cold water to just below the steam hole.

title: Step 2
instruction: Fill filter basket with medium-coarse coffee. Level off; do not tamp.

title: Step 3
instruction: Assemble: water chamber on bottom, filter in middle, empty serving chamber on top.

title: Step 4
instruction: Place on stove over medium heat (serving spout points DOWN at this stage).

title: Step 5
instruction: Wait for steam to emerge from the small steam hole near the top.

title: Step 6
instruction: When steam appears: remove from heat. FLIP the entire pot upside-down in one confident motion.

title: Step 7
instruction: Hot water now gravity-drips through coffee into the serving chamber below.

title: Step 8
instruction: Wait 5-8 minutes for all water to drip through. Dripping will slow and stop.

title: Step 9
instruction: Remove spent filter basket. Serve from spout.

title: Step 1
instruction: Fill water tank with fresh filtered water if not already full.

title: Step 2
instruction: Power on machine. Allow it to heat up (15-60 seconds).

title: Step 3
instruction: Place cup under spout. Select desired volume/size.

title: Step 4
instruction: Insert capsule or K-Cup into chamber. Close lever/lid.

title: Step 5
instruction: Press brew button. Machine pierces capsule and forces {water_total}g hot water through.

title: Step 6
instruction: Nespresso espresso: ~25-40ml in 15-25s. K-Cup: ~150-240ml in 30-60s.

title: Step 7
instruction: Remove used capsule. Serve immediately.

title: Prep
instruction: Place Melitta paper filter in flat-bottom dripper. Set on mug or carafe.

title: Prep
instruction: Rinse filter with hot water to remove papery taste. Discard rinse water.
Add ground coffee. Level bed. Start timer.
Pour {water}g water over grounds for bloom. Wet evenly.
Wait 30 seconds for bloom (CO₂ release).
Begin main pour in slow concentric circles from center outward.
Pour steadily in 2-3 pulses to reach {water_total}g, allowing partial drawdown between pours.
Allow full drawdown. Aim for flat, even coffee bed.

title: Step 1
instruction: Grind coffee very coarse (raw sugar texture).

title: Step 2
instruction: Combine with {water_total}g cold/room temp water. Stir to saturate. Cover.

title: Step 3
instruction: Refrigerate 18-24 hours (or room temp 12-16 hours).

title: Step 4
instruction: Strain through fine mesh, then paper filter for maximum clarity.

title: Step 5
instruction: Transfer cold brew concentrate into a nitrogen-compatible keg or whip cream dispenser.

title: Step 6
instruction: Charge with nitrogen (N₂, NOT CO₂ — nitrogen = creamy; CO₂ = fizzy).

title: Step 7
instruction: Shake keg gently. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to let nitrogen absorb.

title: Step 8
instruction: Pour via tap or nozzle into glass. The signature cascading micro-bubble effect appears.

title: Prep
instruction: Place paper filter in cap; rinse with hot water. Attach cap to AeroPress chamber and place on mug.
Add ground coffee. Start timer. Pour all {water_total}g water in steadily.
Stir gently 3-5 times back and forth.

title: 0:15 - Steep
instruction: Let coffee steep. Some will drip through — this is normal in the upright method.

title: 1:00 - Press
instruction: Insert plunger and press down slowly with steady pressure for 20-30 seconds.

title: 1:25 - Finish
instruction: Stop pressing when you hear a hiss (air pushing through the grounds).

title: Done
instruction: Remove AeroPress. Optionally dilute with hot water for an Americano-style cup.
